newsitem.title: USA: Loews files $1 bln stock, debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Loews files $1 bln stock, debt shelf.

text.p: Loews Corp filed Thursday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in common and preferred stock and debt securities.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
Loews Corp, based in New York, is a holding company. Its subsidaries are engaged in a wide range of businesses.

The subsidiaries include property, casualty and life insurance; production and sale of cigarettes; operations of hotels; operation of offshore oil and gas drilling rigs and distribution of watches and clocks.
